natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Prioritize onboarding simplification because completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates durable improvement to activation, completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Verify the onboarding result and the pricing retention tradeoff before committing, since competitor pricing creates urgency but discounts previously reduced retention.
